description: Create reusable admin components: StatsGrid, StatsCard, and useRealtimeSubscription hook. This eliminates ~440 lines of repeated stats display logic and ~200 lines of realtime subscription boilerplate.
steps: Create components/admin/stats-card.tsx component with props: label, value, color, borderColor, icon, className
Create components/admin/stats-grid.tsx component with props: stats (array), columns (2-5)
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/contacts/page.tsx to replace stats grid JSX with <StatsGrid> component
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/inquiries/page.tsx to replace stats grid JSX with <StatsGrid>
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/complaints/page.tsx to replace stats grid JSX (status + priority grids) with <StatsGrid>
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/consultations/page.tsx to replace stats grid with <StatsGrid> if present
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/partnerships/page.tsx to replace stats grid with <StatsGrid> if present
Create hooks/use-realtime-subscription.ts with useRealtimeSubscription() hook that handles INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE events
Create useRealtimeList() hook in hooks/use-realtime-subscription.ts for simplified list state management with realtime
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/contacts/page.tsx to replace manual realtime subscription useEffect with useRealtimeList hook
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/inquiries/page.tsx to replace manual realtime subscription with useRealtimeSubscription hook (it uses custom state management)
acceptance_criteria: StatsCard and StatsGrid components render stats with correct styling on at least 4 admin pages
useRealtimeSubscription hook handles INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE events correctly
At least 2 admin pages use the new realtime hooks
Manual test: Open admin/contacts page, submit a new contact form in another tab, verify new contact appears in realtime without refresh
Manual test: Stats grids show correct counts
verification: Manual testing: Visit localhost:3000/admin/contacts, verify stats grid displays 'Unread', 'Read', 'Responded' counts
Manual testing: Visit localhost:3000/admin/complaints, verify both status and priority stats grids
Manual testing: Visit localhost:3000/admin/inquiries, verify stats grid with 5 stats
Realtime test: Open admin/contacts, submit contact form in another tab, verify new entry appears without page refresh
Realtime test: Same for inquiries page
